title: SLC Downtown Evening Bites & Landmarks Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This evening tour combines history, architecture, scenic views, and local flavors — all in one seamless downtown experience. Unlike standard night tours that simply drive past landmarks, this tour includes meaningful stops at the Utah State Capitol, a curated chocolate tasting at Caputo’s Market, and a relaxed visit to Church & State for artisan ice cream inside a beautifully restored historic building dating back to 1893. It’s a balanced, immersive introduction to Salt Lake City that blends culture, views, and a true taste of Utah in just 90 minutes.
